note: The sensory integration training with the Early Learning Institute on November 2, 2026, 9 to 12, logged as a PD day with 3 hours for the ten educators who attended

blocks.title: Sensory integration, the senses, heavy work and the four patterns
blocks.why: How children take in sensation and organize it, heavy work and body awareness, and four patterns an educator can read in a child, with strategies for each.

blocks.title: Plus delta
blocks.why: Each educator writes what went well and what to change in TREE on their phone, and a few are shared aloud before leaving.
